intro: These milestones reflect the environments where I have tested ideas, practiced discipline, and learned to work through challenging problems.

awards.name: 1st Place — Massachusetts High School Small Team
awards.description: Team competition at MAMS: answered 30 questions with a score of 28/30.

awards.name: Climate Resilience Award Finalist — Modeling the Future Challenge
awards.description: CRA extension focused on Boston ZIP codes 02126, 02131, and 02127 — targeting PM2.5 exposure with infrastructure and AV deployment where impact matters most.

awards.name: MTFC Finalist
awards.description: Top 3 teams in the Northeast district and Top 15 nationally. Modeled how government policy influences autonomous vehicle adoption and climate mitigation.

awards.name: Top 20% — MathWorks Math Modeling Challenge (M3C)
awards.description: Built a multi-model system for sports gambling impacts: regression and TabNet on ~3M data points, probabilistic betting models, and a network contagion model for social spread.

awards.name: Bronze — ACSL Finals (Senior Division)
awards.description: Bronze medal at the international ACSL Finals — algorithms, programming, computational thinking, and logical problem-solving.

awards.name: FIRST Leadership Award — FRC
awards.description: One of two recipients selected from 54 students — recognized for mechanical design, community outreach, and building the team's social media platform.

awards.name: Top 20% — NYT “Growing Up With A.I.” Challenge
awards.description: Essay on growing up with AI — human element, positives and negatives, and how facts make it hard to see both sides at once.

awards.name: Meritorious — HiMCM
awards.description: Top 13% internationally in the High School Mathematical Contest in Modeling; advances to IM²C.

awards.name: Semifinalist — Modeling the Future Challenge
awards.description: Semifinal round model on drought risk, insurance value, and long-term profitability in corn production under competition constraints.

awards.name: Top 25% Worldwide — IMC Prosperity Trading Competition
awards.description: Developed trading algorithms and led a team of five to a net profit of 73,000 tokens.

awards.name: 2nd Place — Kukkiwon World Taekwondo Hanmadang (Elite Team)
awards.description: Silver medalist in TDE-0501 Team Demonstration at one of the world's premier traditional Taekwondo festivals.

awards.name: 3rd Place — Kukkiwon World Taekwondo Hanmadang (Individual)
awards.description: Individual Creative Breaking, 15–17 M 2.dan — original routine with unique kicks.

awards.name: MAML Finalist (2024–2025)
awards.description: Advanced to the final round with a score of 126 against top students across Massachusetts.

awards.name: Top 5 Varsity — WOCOMAL (Highest-Scoring Sophomore)
awards.description: Top 5 varsity ranking in WOCOMAL as the highest-scoring sophomore.

awards.name: 1st Place U1600 — Nathanael Greene Chess Tournament
awards.description: First place in the U1600 section at the Nathanael Greene Chess Tournament.

awards.name: 4th Place Overall (Freshman) — WOCOMAL
awards.description: Fourth place overall in the freshman division of WOCOMAL.

awards.name: Grand Award — Johns Hopkins CTY
awards.organization: Johns Hopkins Center for Talented Youth
awards.description: Grand Award recognition from Johns Hopkins Center for Talented Youth.

awards.name: 1st Place — New England Online Scholastic Championships
awards.description: First place in the New England Online Scholastic Championships.

awards.name: 2× 2nd Place — Massachusetts State & Korean Consul General
awards.description: Two second-place finishes at Massachusetts State and Korean Consul General events.

awards.name: 3× President's Volunteer Service Award (Gold)
awards.description: Three consecutive Gold Awards for 100+ service hours annually — community service and leadership.

awards.name: 7× Podium Finisher — U.S. Masters Open
awards.description: Seven podium finishes in traditional forms and breaking (Grandmaster Jae H. Jeong & Master Hee Y. Kim).

awards.name: National Qualifier — MathCON
awards.description: Qualified for national finals with a score of 262 (97th percentile); unable to attend due to personal reasons.

awards.name: 9th Place — Science Olympiad States (Fermi Estimation)
awards.description: Ninth in Fermi Estimation — rapid approximation, dimensional analysis, and quantitative reasoning under time pressure.

awards.name: Taekwondo 2nd Dan
awards.description: Second-degree black belt achievement.

awards.name: Student Organizer — MAMS Math Tournament
awards.organization: Massachusetts Academy of Math and Science
awards.description: Co-founded a competitive math tournament for middle and high school students; raised $1,000+ from AoPS, Jane Street, RSM, and The Actuarial Foundation.

awards.name: USCF Tournament Director
awards.description: Certified tournament director experience in organized scholastic chess.
